verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own docs show its core product surface is API- and SDK-driven: sessions, agents, scrape, crawl, extract, profiles, recordings, proxies, stealth and CAPTCHA solving all have programmatic access, plus an official MCP server and CLI. However, nothing documents parity with the UI or dashboard, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so full API coverage of every UI function is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that account, API-key, usage and billing management can be done via the API, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
